candidates.title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
candidates.reason: KVLearn makes cache admission/retention cost-aware in disaggregated serving, jointly modeling reuse, recompute, network transfer and storage; reports up to 56% TTFT reduction and 53% less transfer volume.

candidates.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Production-oriented sparse prefill attention with paged KV cache, continuous batching and SGLang integration; reports large 128K-context speedups on H20 GPUs.

candidates.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
candidates.reason: Production paged-serving KV layer using asymmetric paging for shared prefixes versus request suffixes plus regime-aware backend dispatch; reports up to 2.16x output-token throughput.

discovery_stats.axis: forward citations of Mooncake for KV-centric disaggregated serving
